title: koeleria cristata
intro: Koeleria cristata, commonly known as June Grass or Prickly June Grass, is a perennial grass species native to Europe, Asia, and Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of coughs, respiratory issues, and digestive problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria cristata include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy and safety for human use.
